extraFacts.fact: NPTF is the Dryseal tapered pipe thread of SAE J476, which seals on the thread.

faqs.q: What is the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings and what is it used for?
faqs.a: The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings are a PTFE hose fitting from Parker Hannifin in stainless steel, steel (male nptf pipe, rigid, straight). It is listed in 9 part numbers, such as 10193N-8-8 and 10193N-16-16C, and the Sizes & Part Numbers tab gives the connections for each number. See all [R14 PTFE hose ends](/c/r14-ptfe-hose-ends).

faqs.q: How do I read the Parker Hannifin part number 10193N-8-8 on the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings?
faqs.a: In 10193N-8-8, 10193N is the style and series code and the two numbers after it are sizes in sixteenths of an inch. The size table gives 10193N-8-8 as: 93N SERIES FITTING MALE NPTF T. Other numbers follow the same pattern, for example 10193N-16-16C and 10193N-8-8C.

faqs.q: Which hose goes with the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings?
faqs.a: A Parker Hannifin fitting is rated only on the hose it is designed for, and the listing for the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings does not name a hose series. Quote the hose type and size with the part number and we will check the match before supply.

faqs.q: What sizes does the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings come in?
faqs.a: The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings are listed in 9 part numbers with sizes from 1/2 Inch to 2 Inch in the item text. The size table shows the connections for each number.

faqs.q: What connection does the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings have?
faqs.a: The size table describes the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings as male nptf pipe, rigid, straight. Check the row for your part number to see the size and connection of each end.

faqs.q: What pressure is the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings rated for?
faqs.a: The listing for the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings gives no pressure rating, so we do not quote one. Tell us the hose and the working pressure and we will confirm the fitting before you order, because the assembly is rated to its lowest-rated part.

faqs.q: What is the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings made from?
faqs.a: The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings are listed in stainless steel, steel. The listing gives no plating or finish detail. Ask us if the fluid or the environment needs a different material.

faqs.q: Which thread standard does the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings use?
faqs.a: The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings have an NPTF tapered pipe thread end. NPTF is the Dryseal tapered pipe thread of SAE J476, which seals on the thread. Match the end to a port of the same standard.

faqs.q: What does the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings connect to?
faqs.a: The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings are a hose fitting for PTFE hose, and the other end connects to the thread described in the size table. See the [R14 PTFE hose ends](/c/r14-ptfe-hose-ends) for the sizing of PTFE hose, where the dash size is not the bore.

faqs.q: Can Indus make up a hose assembly with the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings?
faqs.a: Yes. Send the hose type and size, the overall length and both end fittings, and Indus will make up and pressure-test the assembly with the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings. See [what to send for a hose quote](/blog/what-to-send-for-a-hose-quote).

faqs.q: How does the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings differ from the R14 PTFE Hose End × NPTF Male, Steel?
faqs.a: The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings and the [R14 PTFE Hose End × NPTF Male, Steel](/p/r14-ptfe-hose-end-x-nptf-male-steel) are two listings in the same range. They differ in brand Parker Hannifin here against Indus Hydraulics; material Stainless Steel, Steel here against carbon steel. Choose by the thread on your port and the hose, then confirm both in the size tables.

faqs.q: Can I buy the Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings from stock in the UAE and get a quotation?
faqs.a: Yes. The Parker 93N Series PTFE Hose Fittings sit in stock in our Dubai, UAE warehouse and goes out worldwide with the best lead times. Quote the part numbers you need via [the contact page](/contact) and we will confirm price and dispatch.
